property_summary: For any admissible Collect(_am) that succeeds, the caller's recorded balance must decrease by exactly _am; the mutant subtracts only _am-1, so a successful Collect leaves the caller with one extra wei of recorded balance.
change_summary: Change the subtraction line 21 from `acc.balance - _am` to `acc.balance - (_am - 1)`, changing the post-Collect balance after the external call.
